channel.title: From the Heel of Italy
channel.description: Updates from the Pieno Vangelo ministry and the Ronchi family: our church in Modugno, Il Rifugio, missions and church planting across Puglia and beyond.

item.title: After School Is Back
item.description: Our after-school program for the children of immigrant families has started again, led by a missionary couple who came home with a heart for the nations living among us.

item.title: A Season of Growing Leaders
item.description: After years of big changes, God is raising up new leaders in our church and sharing the load in ways we had prayed for. We are grateful and full of hope.

item.title: Getting Ready for a New Kitchen
item.description: We are getting ready to completely renovate the kitchen at Il Rifugio, one of the biggest investments the center has made in the last ten years.

item.title: Four New Workers, Sent from Our Church
item.category: To the Ends of the Earth
item.description: Four believers from our church are heading to the unreached nations, one of them this very month. Here is their story, and why Italians are well placed to go.

item.title: A New Season at Home
item.description: Johanna has started preschool, Amedeo is growing fast, and we are learning to protect what matters most in a busy and beautiful season.

item.title: Standing with Potenza and Massafra
item.description: Alongside the new church in Giugliano, we walk beside two churches facing real challenges: Potenza and Massafra.

item.title: A New Church in Giugliano
item.description: In 2021 Connect Church was born in Giugliano, near Naples, with thirteen people baptized on its very first day. This is the story of how it began.
